title: First and last character
prompt: Return the first character of the text joined to the last one. The text always has at least one character.
starter:
func solve(text: String) -> String:
	return text
hint: Characters can be picked out by position with square brackets, just like array items.
solution:
func solve(text: String) -> String:
	return text[0] + text[text.length() - 1]
